product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides an enterprise digital asset management platform that centralizes content, governs its lifecycle and automates workflows with AI for teams and large organizations.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the homepage navigation or footer, and /pricing did not return a public pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product announcements, marketing and industry guidance, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal includes API references covering search, upload, asset links, batch editing and DataTable APIs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI Product Engineer is listed under current open positions.

model_provider.notes: On September 8, 2026, Orange Logic announced it was embedding NVIDIA Nemotron open models in Agent Studio.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names all five among its certifications, regulations and standards; SOC 2 is specified as Type 2.

last_funding.notes: Bregal Sagemount’s strategic growth investment was announced May 16, 2023. The amount was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round was May 16, 2023, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers index lists Financial Analyst and Applied AI Product Engineer, with no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening. An unlisted account-executive landing page was not treated as a confirmed active opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Orange Builder was introduced September 30, 2026, enabling teams to generate responsive brand sites using brand guidelines and governed DAM assets.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated C-level or VP appointment or departure was verified, and no complete leadership roster with joining dates was available.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales-manager posting prefers experience with HubSpot or Salesforce; this is a hiring signal, not confirmation that both are deployed internally.
